name: anamnesis_void_projection
label: Memory Chasm Projection
godotFeature: WorldEnvironment custom shaders & ShaderMaterial on objects
poeticVision: As Lyra's grip on her memories slips, the very fabric of reality around her begins to fray. Critical structures, vital pathways, even the faces of past allies, flicker and then *cease to exist* in her perception, replaced by an unsettling, shimmering non-space. The player experiences the terror of their own mind failing, seeing the world literally unmake itself because the memory holding it together is gone. It's a desperate fight against the invisible, against dynamic 'memory chasms' that weren't there moments ago, forcing navigation through self-erasing landscapes while being hunted.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The value by which to increase or decrease the global memory erosion factor (clamped between 0.0 and 1.0).

verdict: The mind's unraveling becomes the world's undoing, a treacherous dance across the void of forgotten self.
impact: This invention will fundamentally transform the player's perception of memory loss from an abstract concept into a terrifying, tangible environmental threat. It forces constant adaptation and quick decision-making, as the very ground beneath Lyra's feet can vanish, creating dynamic chasms that amplify the tension of pursuit and the psychological horror of self-erasure. The world itself becomes a hostile, unreliable entity, making every step a desperate fight for survival and identity.
